headline:
تسريب يكشف بيانات
نسخة Master Quest
label: تسريب
showcase_reason: source 720p, Nintendo store copy only; IGN and press site had no larger copy (8 Nov UK launch Reel)
lowres_ok: Nintendo US store overview trailer is the only copy found; IGN video search could not be read from here
note: Leak chip; joint attribution (MrCheeze found the MQ strings; DLC and mirrored lines given to OatmealDome by Nintendo Everything and to MrCheeze by VGC's embed). No individual name on screen. L4 (Aonuma) dropped; lines shortened by editor decision (option 1): IGN unreadable. Track: 111.0 to 125.8 s of the overview's own score, speech none (speechcheck). Shots in source order. Not queued.

angle.why_now: The datamine turned up in the first days after launch and a second dataminer report (VGC, 9 Nov) added the DLC detail; Nintendo has not commented on the leak.
angle.what_it_means_here: Master Quest is the harder, mirrored remix of the 1998 dungeons from the GameCube release; if the data is real, the mode would be paid DLC, not part of the base game, and nothing is announced.
angle.payoff: Nothing confirmed: the data is incomplete, Nintendo has not commented, Aonuma has not announced anything specific.
